description: zlib compression library - built from source with MSVC. Ships shared + static libs and a luarocks-compatible static prefix.
notes: Built from source at install time: needs CMake (pulled in as a dependency) and MSVC (Visual Studio Build Tools with the VCTools workload).
bin\z.dll            shared runtime      (1.3.2 renamed this from zlib.dll)
static\lib\zlib.lib copy of zs.lib under the name LuaRocks/autotools ask for
Point CMake at the prefix itself (ZLIB_ROOT=<dir>).
Point LuaRocks at the static view (ZLIB_DIR=<dir>\static) - that links the static
library and needs no runtime DLL, which is what lua-zlib and zipwriter want.

script: Write-Host '  Configuring zlib with CMake...' -ForegroundColor DarkGray
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { abort "zlib: CMake configure failed. Is a Visual Studio C++ toolset installed?" }
if (!(Test-Path "$dir\lib\zs.lib")) { abort 'zlib: expected lib\zs.lib (static) was not produced.' }
# Static view: expose the static library under the name LuaRocks asks for.
# Deliberately NOT placed in lib\ - putting an import library called zlib.lib
# next to a static one is exactly how you end up linking the wrong thing.
